line.a_teatr.text: Tonight we're putting on a shadow theatre!

line.a_lalki.text: But we don't have any puppets.

line.a_z_ksztaltow.text: We'll make them from shapes. Every piece has its place. A house first.

line.a_pomoge.text: I'll help! This triangle goes on the roof.

line.a_nie_pasuje.text: It doesn't fit! This triangle is wrong. I'm throwing it away.

line.a_nie_wyrzucaj.text: Bear, don't throw it away! The triangle is fine, it's just turned the wrong way.

line.a_obroc.text: Tap a piece and it turns. Turn it until it fits, then drag it into place.

line.a_pasuje.text: It fits! It only needed turning.

line.a_do_teatru.text: The first puppet is ready. Let's go to the theatre!

line.b_ekran.text: What a big screen! There's a lamp shining behind it.

line.b_ryba.text: Make a fish on the screen. Tap to turn and drag the pieces into place.

line.b_plynie.text: Look, the fish's shadow is swimming!

line.b_lodka.text: Now a boat! Make it from the pieces.

line.b_plynie_lodka.text: The boat is rocking on the waves!

line.b_plakat.text: Look, the poster of our show! Oh no, it's torn.

line.b_plakat_kot.text: The poster shows the fish and the boat, we have those already. But there is a cat too, and we have no cat yet!

line.b_plakat_uszy.text: Let's see which pieces it is made of. Point to the cat's ears.

line.b_plakat_nie.text: That's not an ear. The cat's ears are on top of its head, pointed like triangles.

line.b_plakat_trojkaty.text: The ears are two small triangles, and the head is a turned square. We have pieces like these!

line.b_kot.text: From the same shapes we'll make something completely new: a cat!

line.b_czyj_nie.text: Look at the shadow's shape: the ears, the tail, the paws.

line.b_przedstawienie.text: The show is ready! A round of applause for the actors!

line.b_koniec.text: The best theatre in the world!

line.p_start.text: Let's make pictures from pieces! I have five games.

line.p_luka.text: The cat has lost an ear: point to the piece that fits the gap.

line.p_za_duzy.text: That triangle has the right shape, but it's too big. Look for a smaller one.

line.p_inny.text: That piece has a different shape from the gap.

line.p_czyj.text: Point to whose shadow this is.

line.p_jez.text: It's the hedgehog's shadow! It has spikes.

line.h_kwadrat.text: Look: you cut a paper square into two triangles.

line.h_dobrze.text: Lovely! The same pieces, different pictures.

line.h_rodzice.text: Cut a square out of paper with your parents, cut it into triangles and make pictures together. And in the evening put on a shadow theatre with a torch!

line.a_patrz.text: Look, it's the same triangle. I tap it once, and once more.

line.a_dach.text: And now its point is up, like a roof!

line.a_aha.text: Oh! It wasn't wrong, just turned.

line.b_podarl.text: That was me, my paw caught it. Let's put it back together!

line.b_miny.text: Before the show, actors practise their faces. Practise with me!

line.b_miny_ok.text: Now we're ready for the show!

line.p_kwadrat.text: First make a square from two triangles.

line.p_kwadrat_ok.text: Yes, two triangles make a square!

line.p_ucho_ok.text: Yes, the small triangle! The cat has two ears again.

line.p_kropki.text: Join the dots from the smallest and a shadow will appear.

line.p_ptak.text: Yes, it's a bird's shadow! It has wings and a beak.

line.p_rakieta_ok.text: Yes, a rocket of squares and triangles! Off to the stars!

line.h_wrocilismy.text: The show is over, and I want more!

line.h_tutaj.text: Let's put on a shadow theatre right here, on the wall. We need a light.

line.h_lampka.text: Put the lamp on the rug so it shines on the wall.

line.h_swieci.text: It shines on the wall! Now a puppet.

line.h_lis.text: Let's make a fox: a big head and two pointed ears.

line.h_ucho.text: This ear doesn't fit. I'll throw it under the bed!

line.h_obroc.text: Bear, again? Don't throw it away, just turn it!

line.h_aha.text: Oh, right! Make the fox with me.

line.h_lis_ok.text: The fox is nodding on the wall!

line.h_choinka.text: And now make a tree from the same pieces.

line.h_pudelko.text: Bedtime, the pieces go back in the box: point to the one that fits the gap.

line.h_pudelko_nie.text: That piece has a different shape from the gap.

line.h_pudelko_ok.text: Yes, the green slanted piece! Every piece is in its place.

line.h_teatr.text: The loveliest shadow theatre, right in our room!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for a wonderful theatre! Here is a sticker for your album, as a keepsake. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is a colourful block. We got it when we made puppets from pieces for Owl's shadow theatre.
